messages:
deploybot: Deploy started — tag v2.14.0-rc3, commit a1b2c3d, env=canary, pipeline=build → lint → unit → integration → smoke
jorge: ack, watching the pipeline :eyes:
deploybot: build: PASSED, lint: PASSED, unit: PASSED
deploybot: integration: FAILED (2 failing tests) — failing job: integration-suite (node-7)
emily: ugh, looks like TestDBConnection flake again, saw similar in #eng-runtime last month
liam: can we just rerun the integration job first? might be transient
rina: if it's a query timeout from the new client patch, rerun won't help — we should check logs before deciding
deploybot: integration logs: error: timeout after 10s connecting to db; stack snippet:
```
db/connector.go:142: query context deadline exceeded
helpers/retry.go:58: retries exhausted
integration/tests/db_test.go:87: TestDBConnection
```
qa-bot: noted flaky test fingerprint: integration::TestDBConnection (seen 3x in 7 days)
emily: that stack points to the DB connection pool change in a1b2c3d — probably not a transient flake
jorge: tagging @release-manager and @eng-oncall. we should decide canary hold vs rollback. change window is open for next 30m
release-manager: oncall, what's impact if we pause canary? can we keep traffic on stable?
liam: stable is already at v2.13.4, traffic routing can stay there. canary shouldn't take production traffic until green
release-manager: proposal: abort canary rollout and rollback canary nodes to v2.13.4. create hotfix branch to investigate. anyone object?
rina: +1 rollback. prefer not to pin; need full repro before doing a dev patch release
emily: agree, rollback and cut a hotfix branch from a1b2c3d for diagnostics
jorge: deploybot, initiate rollback to v2.13.4 on canary
deploybot: Rollback started — target tag=v2.13.4, env=canary, initiated_by=jorge, reason=integration test failures
deploybot: rollback: step=drain-canary, step=deploy-v2.13.4, step=verify-smoke
devops-bot: running smoke checks post-rollback...
deploybot: smoke: PASSED on canary (post-rollback)
deploybot: rollback completed successfully — canary now at v2.13.4 (commit f9e8d7c)
release-manager: good call. updating release notes and changelog: https://internal.redwood/release/notes/v2.14.0-rc3 (marked aborted canary)
emily: filing follow-up ticket with repro steps and heap/profile logs: RD-5432
qa-bot: marking canary run as aborted, flagging integration::TestDBConnection for quarantine until investigation
liaм: (typo: liam) — leaving a note to revert the DB pool tweak in the hotfix if we confirm causation
jorge: logging postmortem stub and assigning owners: RD-5432 -> emily, RD-5433 -> infra for load testing
release-manager: we'll hold the change window open for 1h to allow hotfix if needed, otherwise reschedule a smaller rollout tomorrow morning
rina: thanks everyone — please add any extra logs to RD-5432
jorge: thanks, closing thread once postmortem ticket created :thumbsup:
